_doc: The owner's chrono-nutrition plan as data. `timeline` is the single source: the Timeline, Matrix, Circadian overlay, Absorption check, Hemodynamics gaps, Supermarket list and Dossier are all derived from it. Item `qty` is per day; `days_per_week` scales it to the weekly list; `pack` is the shop's unit the weekly total is rounded UP to.

timeline.title: Meal 1: Lunch (Calcium Window)
timeline.body: Greek yogurt and oats. Take the multivitamin and omega-3 here.

timeline.title: Meal 2: Pre-workout (fast gastric)
timeline.body: Whey isolate and a banana. Zero fat to speed digestion.

timeline.title: Meal 3: Dinner (zero dairy)
timeline.body: Chicken or tofu with rice. Take creatine here.

objectives.title: Calcium cordoning
objectives.body: Dairy is restricted to lunch to prevent iron and zinc blocking at dinner.

objectives.title: Gastric clearance
objectives.body: Whey isolate pre-workout prevents blood pooling in the GI tract.

objectives.title: NMDA block
objectives.body: Magnesium is replaced heavily at bedtime.

objectives.title: Electrolyte replacement
objectives.body: Sauna and training sodium loss is replaced with electrolytes.

biomarkers.label: Ferritin
biomarkers.note: Goal above 75 ng/mL. Crucial for oxygen transport.

biomarkers.label: Plasma zinc
biomarkers.note: Goal 90 to 130 ug/dL. Protected by the zero-dairy dinner.

biomarkers.label: RBC magnesium
biomarkers.note: Goal above 5.8 mg/dL. Replaced heavily at bedtime.

culinary.method: Soak, then boil legumes and grains
culinary.effect: Soaking and cooking lowers phytate, which binds minerals in the gut.
culinary.how: Soak overnight, discard the water, boil until soft.

culinary.method: Pair plant iron with vitamin C
culinary.effect: Vitamin C keeps non-heme iron soluble so it is absorbed.
culinary.how: Add lemon juice, peppers or citrus to rice, tofu and pulses.

culinary.method: Cook tomatoes with a little fat
culinary.effect: Heat breaks cell walls and fat carries the carotenoid across the gut wall.
culinary.how: Simmer in olive oil rather than eating raw.

culinary.effect: Long, dry, hot cooking oxidises the fats; steaming or baking keeps them.
culinary.how: Steam or bake at moderate heat instead of deep frying.

culinary.method: Keep heme-iron meat away from dairy
culinary.effect: Calcium competes with iron and zinc at the same gut transporter.
culinary.how: Cook chicken for dinner, dairy stays at lunch.

culinary.method: Cook and cool rice, reheat to steaming
culinary.effect: Cooling converts some starch to resistant starch.
culinary.how: Cook ahead, refrigerate quickly, reheat until steaming hot.

clash._doc: Absorption clash rules, evaluated in order, first match wins. `protein_has_any` / `cofactor_has_any` match the tags of the chosen protein source and co-factor; the last rule is the default.

rules.title: Antagonism detected
rules.text: Calcium heavily blocks duodenal absorption of iron and zinc.

rules.title: Sub-optimal
rules.text: Yogurt blocks its own trace minerals, so keep it to the lunch window.

rules.title: Optimal synergy
rules.text: Transporter sites are clear. Heme iron and zinc from meat absorb freely.
